painting-mss.name: Painting
painting-mss.title: Mara Bringing the Demons to Life
painting-mss.reason: This is a Pahari (Guler) ink drawing illustrating a Buddhist/Hindu narrative scene (Mara creating demons), a classic example of the Guler school of Pahari painting, consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

painting-mss.name: Drawing
painting-mss.title: Rama and Lakshmana Visit the Hermitage of an Ascetic
painting-mss.reason: A red-ochre line drawing of a Ramayana scene (Rama, Lakshmana, an ascetic and sage) made in the Pahari Hills (Guler/Kangra) painting tradition, consistent with the claimed Pahari culture.

painting-mss.name: Painting
painting-mss.title: Building the Bridge to Lanka
painting-mss.reason: This is a Kangra-style ink drawing depicting the Ramayana episode of the monkey army (vanaras) building the bridge to Lanka, with Rama and Lakshmana seated at right — classic Pahari Hills court painting subject matter and style, consistent with the Pahari attribution.

painting-mss.name: Drawing
painting-mss.title: Shiva and Parvati in a Mountain Grotto
painting-mss.reason: A Pahari-style ink drawing of Shiva and Parvati in a mountain grotto, from Guler in the Pahari Hills — a classic subject and production of this painting tradition.

painting-mss.name: Drawing
painting-mss.title: Bhagat Sen Worshipping Vishnupada
painting-mss.reason: A Pahari ink drawing from Guler depicting a worshipper (Bhagat Sen) venerating a Vishnupada shrine, a classic Pahari Hills manuscript-painting tradition and style.

painting-mss.name: Drawing
painting-mss.title: Vishnu on Garuda Slaying a Demon
painting-mss.reason: A Pahari-style drawing from Guler depicting Vishnu riding Garuda slaying a demon, consistent with the hill-painting tradition attributed to the Pahari region of the Himalayan foothills.

painting-mss.name: Drawing
painting-mss.title: Page from a Sketchbook Showing Rulers on Horseback, Boars, and a Palace Scene
painting-mss.reason: A Pahari (Guler) sketchbook page with ink drawings of mounted riders, boars, and a palace court scene — this is a classic Pahari Hills painting tradition sketch, consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

painting-mss.name: Painting
painting-mss.title: Shiva and Parvati
painting-mss.reason: A Pahari-style ink drawing of Shiva and Parvati with their mount animals, a classic subject and style of the Pahari Hills painting tradition (Himalayan foothills of India/Nepal border region), consistent with the claimed Pahari attribution.

painting-mss.name: Painting
painting-mss.title: Building the Bridge to Lanka
painting-mss.reason: This is a Pahari Hills (Guler) ink-and-wash drawing depicting monkeys building the bridge to Lanka, a Ramayana scene — a classic subject and style of the Pahari painting schools, matching the claimed ethnicity.
